owner_approval: 2026-10-14, in chat: 'yes run A22, then A21, then A20'
why_this_exists: Lee, Sun, Wang & Zhang (2019) report the technology-link lead-lag also appears in earnings surprises. A firm whose linked peers just reported strong earnings may be next: the information arrives through demand, not price. A19 and A21 test peers' PRICES; this tests peers' REPORTED EARNINGS, which the market may read more slowly. Caution recorded in the design doc, from memory: Thomas & Zhang (JAR 2008) find late announcers overreact to early announcers' news.

data.sue: evidence/extended_sue_panel_v1/sue_panel.csv.gz: SUE (seasonal random walk on quarterly EPS, scaled by the std of the previous eight surprises) using only facts filed strictly before each decision; 58 quarterly decisions 2012-04-01 to 2026-07-01, 131,169 rows
data.networks: TNIC-3 (A19) and VTNIC 10% (A21), mapping and July-lag timing as A19

decisions: the SUE panel's quarterly dates (1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct); signals use prices up to the last trading day BEFORE the decision date; forward return over the next 63 trading days, non-overlapping
windows: design 2012-04 to 2018-10 (27 decisions); holdout 2019-01 to 2025-04 for T1 (TNIC to June 2025), 2019-01 to 2023-04 for T2 (VTNIC to June 2023)

trials.T1_product_peers_sue_3m: score-weighted mean SUE of the firm's TNIC-3 peers that have a SUE at the decision
trials.T2_customers_sue_3m: vertscore-weighted mean SUE of the firm's 10 nearest VTNIC customers (A21's T1 partner set) that have a SUE
trials.residualisation: each decision, OLS on own SUE, own 63-day return, own 12-1 momentum and the leave-self-out SIC2 63-day return; only the residual is ranked. Firms without their own SUE are excluded (own SUE must be controlled).

measurement: A19's screen and pass rule, with a block bootstrap of block 2 (quarterly, non-overlapping), 200-draw shuffled-network placebo, decile_shape clears and clears_calibrated, leave-outs, holdout.
power_declared_in_advance: UNDERPOWERED BY DESIGN. 27 design decisions against Step 300's ~38 needed to see an IC of 0.03 at t=3. A fail here is weak evidence; a pass would be the survivor of a small sample and of the whole search. Monthly SUE would need the Company Facts cache rebuilt (queue S10).
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Survivorship: Company Facts is a current pull; SUE coverage is 54% before 2016 and 91% from 2020 (Step 256).
Quarterly snapshot: a peer's SUE may be up to three months old at the decision, so this tests slow diffusion over weeks, not the days after an announcement.
T2 depends on A21's VTNIC network; if A21's positive control fails, T2 is uninterpretable and is reported as such.
